items.headline: US and Iran Pause Military Strikes for Diplomacy, Triggering Sharp Drop in Oil Prices
items.summary: The United States and Iran have temporarily halted military strikes to give diplomatic negotiations mediated by regional partners a chance to resolve ongoing tensions. The unexpected pause in hostilities brought immediate relief to global markets, causing crude oil prices to fall roughly eight to ten percent.

items.headline: Nvidia and Tech Leaders Launch Open Secure AI Alliance to Combat Cyber Threats
items.summary: Nvidia and over thirty technology organizations launched the Open Secure AI Alliance on July 27 to develop open-source tools for securing artificial intelligence systems. The coalition aims to strengthen cyber defenses against AI-driven threats, though closed-model developers like OpenAI and Google were notably absent from the group.

items.headline: Rookie Jackson Koivun Wins PGA Tour 3M Open in Third Pro Start
items.summary: Twenty-one-year-old golfer Jackson Koivun secured his first PGA Tour title at the 3M Open in just his third tournament as a professional. He finished with a tournament-record score of 25-under 259 to hold off world number one Scottie Scheffler by three strokes.

items.headline: Grammy Winner Carly Simon Reveals Parkinson's Diagnosis and Announces New Album
items.summary: Legendary singer-songwriter Carly Simon announced on July 27 that she has been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease, explaining her recent absence from the public eye [2.1.8]. Despite her health challenges, the 83-year-old music icon shared that she has been recording a new album titled 'Comes in Waves' scheduled for release in August.
